description: Round-3 Phase 1 — manual seek clears Timeline::sectionAtBreak(). Park playhead at section break (frame 60), then SeekToFrame backward to frame 0; the at-break latch must drop so the subsequent Play advances normally instead of staying stuck. Without the fix, SectionScheduler would still hold m_atBreak true after the backward scrub (its old `currentTime > m_lastBreakHitFrame` unstick guard fails on backward jumps), and the Phase 5 visibility gate could misfire on the new playhead position. Single clip on track 0 spans the break (0..120 timeline frames at 30fps), so the gate has a clip to act on.
